_comment: nhq-sched admission policy for the HP Envy 13 (7.5GB RAM, zram). Tuned for the laptop's real constraint: RAM + concurrency, not cost (nhq-econ owns cost). nhq-sched reads these; absent file → same defaults baked into the bin. Flip enforcement via NHQ_SCHED_MODE=enforce (gated on Yash lifting D6).

_fields.max_alive: concurrency cap — RUNNING+IDLE fleet sessions before a new spawn is QUEUEd (D-F1: maxConcurrency ~2-3 on this box)
_fields.min_free_ram_mb: hard floor — projected free RAM below this → REJECT (admitting risks OOM / earlyoom kill)
_fields.soft_free_ram_mb: soft floor — projected free RAM below this → QUEUE (memory pressure; recommend reaping the longest-IDLE session)
